rule.name: Mimikatz Credential Dumping via CLI Arguments
rule.description: Detects Mimikatz usage based on known command-line arguments used during credential dumping operations. CVE-2022-26923 exploitation commonly uses Mimikatz.
rule.query: process where process.name : ("mimikatz.exe", "mimilib.dll") or process.command_line : ("sekurlsa::*", "lsadump::*", "privilege::debug") or (process.name : "procdump*.exe" and process.command_line : "*lsass*")
author: Security Team
Elastic
